# Crowned360 Beauty Bar

> Owner-led natural hair care and loc studio in South Augusta, Georgia. Lakeisha Mells specializes in natural hair care and locs: starter locs, interlocs, microlocs, loc extensions, retwists and repairs, plus silk press, natural styles, color, cuts, wigs and scalp treatments. Booking is on StyleSeat.

- Website: https://crowned360-beauty-bar.netlify.app/
- Book online (StyleSeat): https://www.styleseat.com/m/v/crowned360
- Phone (call or text): (762) 245-1983
- Address: 3128 Deans Bridge Rd, Ste D, Augusta, GA 30906 (Deans Bridge Road / US-1, South Augusta, close to I-520 Exit 5)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. After 5 PM, Saturday and Sunday by request with a $35 after-hours fee (call (762) 245-1983).
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Crowned360/
- Ratings: 4.9 from 403 reviews on StyleSeat ("1k+ booked"); 4.7 from 28 Google reviews.
- Recognition: BusinessRate Top 3 Hair Salon, Augusta, GA 30906 (2025), based on Google reviews.

## About

In her own words (StyleSeat): "My name is Lakeisha and I specialize in Natural Hair-Care & Locs. I am here to educate you and to make sure all your hair care needs are met. Please Note: Some services may require a consultation prior to your service."

The salon also stocks its own Crowned360 Beauty Collection (labeled 100% pure organic, vegan and cruelty free), including Fenugreek & Chebe Herbal Hair Oil and Rose Water & Hibiscus Hydrating Mist.

## Price guide (starting prices)

- Loc Re-twist (Only) Neck Length: from $85 (most booked; 5.0 from 24 StyleSeat reviews)
- 360 Signature Silk Press: from $135
- Micro Locs Installation: from $975 (about 8 hours; consultation and $350 deposit required)
- MicroLoc Extensions with hair included: from $2,400
- Microloc Retightening: from $225
- Consultation: from $35

## Policies

- Deposit: paid at booking to secure an appointment; non-refundable; kept if you cancel without rescheduling. StyleSeat lists a $25 deposit.
- Cancelling with less than 24 hours notice: deposit kept, charged the difference between the deposit and 25% of the service price. No-show: 50%.
- Late fee: $25. Holiday fee: $100 (New Year's, July 4th, Thanksgiving, Memorial Day, Christmas Eve and Christmas).
- Micro Locs and Loc Extension Deposit Fee: $350. A consultation is required for all new loc extensions, microlocs and micro twists.

## Booth rental

Booths available for stylists: free Wi-Fi, 24 hour access. Text or call (762) 245-1983.

## FAQ

- How do I book? Online on StyleSeat (https://www.styleseat.com/m/v/crowned360), with a deposit at booking. Questions: call or text (762) 245-1983.
- Do I need a consultation for microlocs? Yes, for all new loc extensions, microlocs and micro twists.
- How much is a loc retwist? From $85 (neck length) or $95 (mid back).
- Are weekend appointments available? By request, with a $35 after-hours fee.
